question_text: A public school teacher, Mrs. Reyes, received a handcrafted wooden plaque worth approximately ₱1,500 from a student's parent during the school's annual appreciation day. The plaque was made by the parent himself and bore a sincere message of gratitude. Under RA 6713 and its implementing rules, which of the following best describes the propriety of Mrs. Reyes accepting this gift?

options.text: It is prohibited because any gift from a parent is considered a conflict of interest.
It is allowed because the gift is of nominal value and given on a special occasion.
It is prohibited because the value exceeds ₱1,000.
It is allowed only if Mrs. Reyes reports it to the school division superintendent within 30 days.
